meta.title: Soil test rating limits and fertilizer-adjustment rules (India / Maharashtra)
meta.note: Units: available N, P, K in kg/ha (0-15 cm). P basis stated per table - national SHC/Methods-Manual P is elemental P (Olsen); Maharashtra 6-class table in the 2011 manual is P2O5; MPKV 2026 table does not state P vs P2O5. Conversion: P2O5 = P x 2.291; K2O = K x 1.2046.
meta.shc_portal_classes: Current SHC portal (soilhealth.dac.gov.in, JS bundle inspected 2026-11-24) classifies N, P, K, OC as Low/Medium/High; pH as Acidic/Neutral/Alkaline; EC as NonSaline/Saline; S, Fe, Zn, Cu, B, Mn as Sufficient/Deficient. Threshold values are computed server-side and were not retrievable (portal GraphQL API not queried).

national_3class.source_name: Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Dept. of Agriculture & Cooperation, GoI, Jan 2011 (hosted on Soil Health Card portal)

available_K_kg_ha.basis: K (as printed 'Available K'; commonly reported as K2O in SHC practice - ambiguity noted)

shc_school_manual_2023.source_name: Soil Sampling & Testing Manual for Class XI-XII Students (MoA&FW / MoE / CBSE, 2023, School Soil Health Programme; hosted on Soil Health Card portal)
shc_school_manual_2023.note: Classes 'used in Digital Soil Testing Mini Lab for 12 soil health parameters'. Differs slightly from 2011 manual (K low <120; adds Very High class).

Mn.note: critical-limit table on next page lists Mn 2.5 mg/kg for STL

shc_school_manual_2023.pH_note: Source table leaves 8.0-8.5 unclassified (gap in source).
shc_school_manual_2023.EC_note: 1:2 soil:water for alluvial (silt loam), 1:5 for black (clay loam) soils - i.e. NOT saturation-extract ECe.

adjustment_rule.source_locator: printed p30 'Recommended Dose of Fertilizers (RDF)' table

maharashtra_6class.source_name: MPKV Rahuri, Krishi Darshani 2026 (official annual diary / package of practices, Marathi; read from page images)
maharashtra_6class.source_locator: PDF p32 (printed p13), table 'jaminitil upalabdha annadravyanchya pramanavarun khatancha vapar'
maharashtra_6class.P_basis: not stated (column 'sphurad', kg/ha); values are close to an elemental-P scale - verify against MPKV soil lab reports
maharashtra_6class.note: Instruction under table: classify each nutrient from the soil test report using this table and apply fertilizer accordingly. RECOMMENDED for TerraByte Maharashtra users.

maharashtra_6class.source_name: Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Dept. of Agriculture & Cooperation, GoI, Jan 2011 (hosted on Soil Health Card portal) - Table 3 'Maharashtra' (citing Tandon H.L.S. 2005)
maharashtra_6class.P_basis: P2O5 kg/ha; K basis K2O kg/ha
maharashtra_6class.note: No adjustment percentages given with this table. Class names differ from MPKV 2026 (here 'medium' = 421-560 N).

maharashtra_6class.source_name: Sharma R.P. et al. (ICAR-NBSS&LUP Nagpur), Indian Farming 70(03):25-28, Mar 2020 - ratings 'suggested by PDKV, Akola' used for SHCs in Kelapur block, Yavatmal
maharashtra_6class.P_basis: 'Olsen P (kg/ha)' as printed - P vs P2O5 not explicit

micronutrient_critical_limits.source_name: MPKV Rahuri, Krishi Darshani 2026 (official annual diary / package of practices, Marathi; read from page images)
micronutrient_critical_limits.remedy: Deficient soils: MPKV micronutrient Grade I (Fe 2%, Zn 5%, Mn 1%, Cu 0.5%, B 1%) 25 kg/ha mixed with 100 kg FYM, incubated ~1 week, soil-applied; or foliar Phule liquid Grade II 50 ml then 100 ml per 10 L.

micronutrient_critical_limits.source_name: Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Dept. of Agriculture & Cooperation, GoI, Jan 2011 (hosted on Soil Health Card portal)
Soil Sampling & Testing Manual for Class XI-XII Students (MoA&FW / MoE / CBSE, 2023, School Soil Health Programme; hosted on Soil Health Card portal)

EC_saturation_extract_general.source_name: Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Dept. of Agriculture & Cooperation, GoI, Jan 2011 (hosted on Soil Health Card portal)
EC_saturation_extract_general.note: Source table skips 2-4 mS/cm. Salt-affected classes (Richards 1954, Table 17): saline ECe>4, ESP<15, pH<8.5; sodic ECe<4, ESP>15, pH>8.5; saline-sodic ECe>4, ESP>15.

pH_methods_manual_partial.source_name: Methods Manual: Soil Testing in India, Dept. of Agriculture & Cooperation, GoI, Jan 2011 (hosted on Soil Health Card portal)
pH_methods_manual_partial.note: Remainder of Table 14 is on printed pages 86-87, which are missing from the scanned PDF on the SHC portal.

secondary_tnau.source_name: TNAU Agritech portal, Soil rating chart (secondary; Tamil Nadu)

adjustment_rules.rule_text: General fertilizer dose is reduced or increased by 30 to 50% in case of high or low fertility status soil sample.
adjustment_rules.source_locator: printed p135 (PDF p139), 'Soil Test Rating and Fertilizer Adjustment'

adjustment_rules.applies_to: SHC colour coding as summarised by Arthapedia (Indian Economic Service) from the SHC Operational Guidelines
adjustment_rules.note: Primary operational guidelines PDF (agricoop.nic.in/imagedefault/GSHC3.pdf) not reachable.

stcr_note: MPKV Krishi Darshani 2026 (PDF p44-50) and MPKV research sheets give STCR targeted-yield equations (e.g. Western Maharashtra wheat with FYM: FN = 7.42T - 0.88SN - 2.45FYM; FP2O5 = 1.59T - 1.47SP - 0.33FYM; FK2O = 4.77T - 0.47SK - 0.65FYM, T in q/ha; KD PDF p67). These were not systematically extracted; see README.
